title: Blåbär
content:
# Blåbär

Affiliation: Hildir | Place of birth: Plains | Species: Lox | Gender: Unknown | Eye color: Yellow

# Introduction

Blåbär is a character found in Meadows. It is a tamed Lox that accompanies Hildir at her trading camp.

## Biography

Nothing is known about Blåbär beyond the fact it is a Lox that resides with Hildir in her camp feeding from a bowl alongside Hallon.

## Trivia

• "Blåbär" is a swedish word, meaning blueberry. It is derived from blå "blue" and bär "berry". Blåbär doesn't refer to the North American blueberry (Vaccinium cyanococcus), but to a related fruit called "bilberry" (Vaccinium myrtillus) "Blåbärssoppa" is a soup made from said fruit.
• Blåbär and Hallon can be pet.
